# Mubarak Shajahan — MK Comics

> Personal portfolio of Mubarak Shajahan (Mohammed Mubarak, முகமது முபாரக்), Senior Software Engineer at Galent, Chennai, India. Full-stack + AI: React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, AWS, LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows. The site is written as a comic book; every number and quote on it is real.

## Who
- Senior Software Engineer at Galent (May 2026 – present). Before that five years at Incresco (June 2021 – May 2026): Software Development Engineer → SDE 1 → SDE 2, building AI and full-stack platforms for Global University Systems.
- Career start: 21 June 2021. B.Tech in Information Technology, Sri Krishna College of Technology, Coimbatore (2018–2022, CGPA 8.01/10). Award: Outstanding contribution and strong ownership, IncrescoTech, 2021.
- Writes for 22,000+ developers on LinkedIn (10M+ impressions) about JavaScript, React and AI.

## Proof (all on the page)
- Sole engineer on EF Academy's primary digital presence: 1.25M+ monthly users, 23+ languages.
- Replaced a licensed TIBCO integration pipeline with AWS Glue before the contract ended: $24,000 → $840 a year (96.5% cut); the VP of Technology counts it as $30,000 saved.
- AI document processing (GPT-4 Vision + OCR): 17+ document types at 95% accuracy, manual entry −70%, processing 7×.
- Chrome extensions saving admins 3–5 hours a day at 99.9% uptime.
- Nine named testimonials, quoted verbatim.
